sources.excerpt: AI Will Replace 300 Million Jobs by 2030—Are You Ready or at Risk? Goldman Sachs

reasoning: The claim that "generative AI will replace 300 million jobs worldwide" is a common mischaracterization of a March 2023 report by Goldman Sachs. The report actually estimated that generative AI could "expose" the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation, meaning that certain tasks within those jobs could be automated. It did not project that 300 million actual workers would lose their jobs or be fully replaced. In fact, the report emphasized that most jobs and industries are only partially exposed to automation and are more likely to be complemented rather than substituted by AI, which could ultimately boost global productivity and create new employment opportunities.
